title: Cancer [Unspecified Skin Cancer, Benign Carcinoid Tumor, in situ Cervical Cancer, Intraepithelial Neoplasia, History Cancer, Complication of Cancer or Treatment] (Disorders) (ICD10CM)
purpose: (Clinical Focus: This set of values contains diagnoses or problems that represent that the patient has Cancer [Unspecified Skin Cancer, Benign Carcinoid Tumor, in situ Cervical Cancer, Intraepithelial Neoplasia, History Cancer, Complication of Cancer or Treatment] regardless of the clinical presentation of the condition. This corresponds to the 2025 NPCR Expanded List for Cancer Reporting, except for the exclusion criteria detailed below.),(Data Element Scope: Diagnoses or problems documented in a clinical record.),(Inclusion Criteria: Cancer (Unspecified Skin Cancer, Benign Carcinoid Tumor, in situ Cervical Cancer, Intraepithelial Neoplasia, History Cancer, Complication of Cancer or Treatment)),(Exclusion Criteria: Cancers in remission, personal history, adverse effect or poisoning from antineoplastic drugs, complications of cancer treatment)
